Eight structures from CoRE MOF 2024's supporting-information subset, as
distributed in CoRE MOF Tools (CoREMOF/data/SI/CR.zip), unchanged:

  2010[Cr][bpq]3[ASR]1.cif  doi:10.1021/jp102463p
  2019[Mn][bpq]3[ASR]1.cif  doi:10.1039/C8DT01185K
  2015[Cu][nan]3[ASR]1.cif  doi:10.1038/ncomms7350 (the round-56 PLD case)
  2023[Co][sql]2[ASR]1.cif  doi:10.1039/D2DT02049A (the round-56 grid-floor case)
  2020[Cd][hcb]2[ASR]1.cif  doi:10.1039/C9CE00113A (the round-57 split-network case)
  2017[ZnSi][nan]3[ASR]1.cif  doi:10.1039/C6CE02639G (the round-58 metalloid case)
  2019[V][bpq]3[ASR]1.cif  doi:10.1039/C8DT04214D (MIL-47(V)-Br, round-59 rebuild check)
  2023[Ni][dia]3[ASR]1.cif  doi:10.1039/D2TA06863J (an -NH2 MOF, round-59 rebuild check)

G. Zhao, L. Brabson, S. Chheda, J. Huang, H. Kim, K. Liu et al., CoRE MOF DB:
a curated experimental metal-organic framework database with machine-learned
properties for integrated material-process screening, Matter 8, 102140 (2025).
